raises.why: The Linear-style revamp (owner approved, to be trimmed before use)
The Linear-style revamp (owner approved, to be trimmed before use)

Age.why: An age with each unit a size smaller, as V1 draws every age.

text.why: The age as the screens write it (38m, 3h 05m, now).

strong.why: An age that stands out in ink (the kit sheet; list rows keep every age at one weight).

Avatar.why: A person's face: a neutral disc with initials in rows, heads, pills and pickers (so a row's status glyph stays its one colour), on their identity hue in the conversation; the empty slot that keeps columns aligned, or a row of faces.

name.why: Initials on the face and its accessible name; none for an empty slot.

seed.why: A stable hue per person (an id, or a Jira assignee's name), for the faces that keep one (the conversation, the large face).

size.why: Five places draw faces at five sizes.

values.sm: A face inside a pill (16px): an agent card's state chip.
values.mid: A neutral face whose initials must read (24px): All teams' team faces.
values.lg: A larger face (30px): the kit sheet's; no screen draws it now.
values.talk: The conversation and the sidebar head's signed-in face (24px), on the person's hue.

dashed.why: The owner picker's Unassigned choice shows a dashed empty face (a row's missing owner is the invisible slot).

people.why: Who works on a repo, who is in a conversation: one row, named together.

Badge.why: Every small labelled chip: keys, counts, keycaps, tags, another system's status, YOU.

kind.why: V1 had a component per chip; one component with a kind each.

values.key: A ticket or project key, as quiet tabular text (how Linear writes an issue id).
values.count: The bare count after a head's or a filter pill's name.
values.tag: A label chip on a hairline: the agent reads' tags, an agent card's chips, All teams' item badge.
values.status: A Jira status, which we only know by name.
values.prop: A list row's quiet property (its stage, its source): a grey dot or a small glyph, then the words, no outline, so the row's one chip stays its only edged thing (Linear's label without its pill).
values.you: The YOU pill: the one mono-caps form.

size.why: Keys sit in rows, group heads and the ticket kicker.

values.sm: Compact's foot and an agent card's key.

title.why: The full text or what a click does, on hover.

href.why: A Jira key opens the issue; V1's small arrow shows on hover, outside the layout, so linked and plain keys end on one edge.

icon.why: A property's glyph in place of its dot (the repo glyph before a row's source).

dot.why: A property's dot in the hue of the state it belongs to (a row's stage on its state's dot), so the stage reads with the row's glyph without a coloured chip.

values.neutral: Waiting on someone else, queued, in the inbox or abandoned: the grey dot (the default).
values.live: Its run is under way: running's orange.
values.you: It waits on you: your move's accent.

tone.why: Count pills and tags take their head's or meaning's hue.

values.quiet: An agent card's state pill and repo, the ticket page's item names: regular muted text on the hairline.
values.fill: An agent card's state and repo: a filled chip with no edge, a face at its end.

Button.why: Every button and button-like link, as Linear's quiet filled controls.

children.why: The label; none makes an icon-only button.

variant.why: V1's gate primacy: at most one strong button per group.

values.default: A filled button on a hairline edge.
values.ink: A primary that isn't a gate (Retry): a firmer neutral fill.
values.accent: Only Dispatch run, only on a ticket.
values.quiet: A borderless button (+N, icon buttons in a bar).
values.lit: A row's one call to action, outlined until its row is hovered, then filled like you (Intake's Take in drew it; only the kit sheet does now, so it retires once the sheet drops it).
values.link: A bare text action in secondary ink, primary on hover (Show all, Open ticket).

values.md: 34px: the top bar and the ticket header.

icon.why: A glyph before the label, or alone (close, open in Jira).

title.why: The tooltip; an icon-only button's name, so it must have one.

blocked.why: The server says why an action is blocked (R11): it stays focusable, does nothing, and says why.

href.why: A link that looks like a button: a path in the app, or out to Jira.

Checklist.why: A plan's items (TASKS.md) with ticks, rings and section heads, drawn three times in V1.

more.why: How many were left out (+N more).

look.why: A row's expansion keeps the bare list; the ticket's and the peek's plan are rows at body size on the page's own ground, as Linear lists sub-issues (no card, no rules).

values.page: The ticket page's plan: 36px rows at body size, quiet section heads.
values.peek: The peek's plan: the same, in shorter rows so its conversation fits beside it.

Dialog.why: The peek: a modal panel on the browser's <dialog> (focus held, Esc, inert page, focus returned).
Dialog.single: Only the peek is a dialog yet; new ticket and the confirms join it in W4.

children.why: Its sections, one hairline apart; they scroll inside the panel.

foot.why: Pinned under the scrolling sections, as Linear's reply box sits at its panel's foot (the peek's composer).

Facts.why: A ticket's properties as one of Linear's labelled property rows: the values at body size, each a muted icon and its words, as chips; each label in its tooltip.
Facts.single: The ticket page and the peek both draw it, through the one properties composition the ticket feature shares with the peek.

items.why: The facts: a label, a value, and quiet words after it (main, from the repo).

label.why: The row's head, as Linear's "Properties" (Properties, Code, Workflow on the ticket page and the peek).

Frame.why: The app's frame: the labelled sidebar in three groups (the views; the headed sections; Settings and the theme at the foot) under its head (the Space's switcher, then search, which takes you to the view's search field, and new ticket, inert until W4 as the page's own button is, as Linear's two icon buttons), and the main column as an inset sheet.
Frame.single: There is one frame: the app's layout draws it around every screen.

space.why: The Space's name and initial on the head's switcher, the sidebar's one menu, as Linear's workspace name.

nav.why: The views at the top of the sidebar, each labelled, with the count of what waits on you there on a small muted badge at the row's end, as Linear's.

sections.why: Headed groups under the views (Context: Agents, Skills), each folding under its heading; an entry with no screen yet (no to) is drawn like a view but leads nowhere and takes no hover.

foot.why: Settings, over the theme row (the theme menu's row trigger, naming the current theme) at the sidebar's foot; Settings has no screen yet, so it is an entry only.

me.why: The signed-in person, inside the Space's switcher as Linear's account is: their face on their own hue and their whole name (W0 has no sign-in, so nothing to sign out of).

Head.why: The head over a zone, a group or a rack group: V1's ZoneHead, GroupHead and the queue's copy.

icon.why: A status glyph or a project key before the name.

tone.why: Needs you and Done heads count in their hue; the name stays in ink.

note.why: A quiet note after the count (Longest wait first).

summary.why: The right slot after the hairline: a stat, links, a JQL.

level.why: Three sizes of head in V1.

values.zone: A band run through its surface's padding, edge to edge (My queue's Agents at work, over its cards).
values.group: A list's band edge to edge (Linear's group head): Compact's and Intake's fold, My queue's lists' don't; the glyph sits over the rows' first cell; in a scrolling list it stays at the top while its rows pass under it.

fold.why: A collapsible group: open or not, and the toggle.

Icon.why: Every glyph: the sidebar's (its head's search and new-ticket compose too) and V1's line icons, the ticket's property glyphs, a section's fold caret, the ticket-type squares and the priority bars (both grey, as Linear's; normal is Linear's three dashes, so the slot's left edge holds), and the tick.

label.why: Its accessible name when nothing beside it says what it is.

Mark.why: A ticket's state in exactly one form per state (V1's StatusMark).

kind.why: One form per state (MarkKind): R12's attention, plus the outcomes.

name.why: Who or what, in the state's colour (in a chip, in ink on the state's dot).

ask.why: What it waits for (Sign off the plan).

glyph.why: The glyph alone: before a row's title (its one accent), counters, legends, heads.

small.why: The glyph a size down, for counters, pills and heads.

chip.why: In a list row, what the state names beyond the glyph, the group and the stage (the agent and its step, who it waits on and for what) as Linear's label chip: a neutral pill on a hairline, no colour of its own, the row's one outlined thing, its step count inside it in a quieter ink.

progress.why: A running glyph's pie fills as far as its run is (Linear's in-progress circle), so a row needs no meter beside it.

Menu.why: A menu of choices, one current: Base UI's combobox keyboard, filter and placement, the kit's one popover opening on its filter, as every kit list of choices does; in the sidebar's foot, opening above its row, its chevron pointing up.
Menu.single: Frame's theme menu draws it today; the ticket's run-from and the dispatch target use it in W4 and W7.

label.why: The trigger's name, and the filter's prompt (Change theme…).

text.why: The trigger as a sidebar row: the glyph, this word, the current choice and a chevron (the foot's Theme row).

Meter.why: A running run's progress, one segment per step, the current one sweeping (V1's RunMeter).

values.tile: A running agent card's: one still 2px track along the card's bottom edge, the finished steps live and the one under way a soft live, under the progress line's count (a queued card draws none).
values.row: Inline in a row (48px): the ticket's Now line.
values.strip: A run's steps each named under its segment; drawn on the kit sheet only, since the ticket page dropped it.

Notice.why: Loading, empty and failure states in V1's quiet language, and a capped list's +N strip.

kind.why: Four quiet lines V1 drew about 25 ways.

values.empty: The quiet row of an empty zone (All quiet — nothing new matches this query).
values.problem: What went wrong under a head (Intake's failing query): a line marked blocked (an edge; in an item list, a dot), at a reading measure.
values.more: +N more, or Show N more, under a capped list.

lead.why: The lead words a step firmer than the rest, set off by a dash (All quiet, All clear, +3 more).

children.why: What it says after the lead.

error.why: A status line that reports a failure.

align.why: Intake's notices are lines of its triage list, not of a banded group: they sit on the list's own columns.

values.item: Intake's two-line items: the row's size, an empty ring or a problem's blocked dot in the group labels' chevron slot, the words after it.
values.end: A status that closes a list, its words ending on the rows' far edge (Intake's checked 2m ago).

fix.why: A problem says what went wrong and, on a muted line of its own, what can be done about it (An admin can fix the query in Settings › Intake), so neither wraps into the other.

Page.why: A view: the top bar (title, context, counters, the view's controls, search, its buttons) and the body.

title.why: The view's name, and the tab's; a list is Linear's breadcrumb, its last step the name; a pair's first step is a link back (the ticket: My queue › NW-17, the way back to the queue).

context.why: Quiet after the title: the Space, a scope, who.

counters.why: The bar's counts; a zero recedes, a non-zero need-you takes the accent's ink, with no fill.

mark.why: The state the count is of (MarkKind).

middle.why: The view's own controls (filter pills, a crumb).

search.why: The search field, with / and Esc.

action.why: The bar's buttons at its right end (New ticket; the ticket's actions).

side.why: A full-height column beside the body, ruled off by one hairline with no card, so what it holds can pin its foot to the window's bottom (the ticket's Talk and its reply box).

Row.why: One item of a list: its cells on the table's columns; a flat row on a hairline (Linear's list), a card or a swimlane.

look.why: Actionable rows are raised, settled ones flat (V1's refresh).

values.flat: Settled: done or closed; a queued agent's card, on a fainter hairline; a board's column head (a band).
values.you: Needs you: drawn as raised; the row's glyph and chip say it.

edge.why: The 3px status edge (the kit sheet; the screens' list rows say a state by its glyph).

kind.why: The five shapes V1's lists take.

values.line: A list's row (Compact, My queue): one line on a hairline, edge to edge, its first cell under the group head's glyph, washed on hover.
values.item: A two-line row (Intake): roomy, on a hairline, washed on hover.
values.tile: An agent card (My queue's Agents at work, Linear's agent card), each line in its own space: the key line with Linear's agent pill at its end (a hairline label, then the agent's glyph on a live disc under the owner's face); the title at regular weight, a still state glyph hanging before it; faint filled label chips (the stage's led by a dot in the card's state); and the progress line (the step, its count) over a track along the bottom edge. The chips and progress sink to the foot so they line up across a row.
values.rack: A bare entry (a team's items): lights up.
values.band: A board's swimlane: the team, then its stage lanes to the board's edge, its items stacked as cards, the board's only raised surface (a slight step above the page on a hairline), their titles wrapping only at the card's edge in a per-theme title ink (one weight in light and dark), each item's badge (a Badge tag) drawn as Linear's label chip, a pill on a hairline with a faint fill (All teams); every stage an equal lane, and a lane with no card bare page (Linear's empty column); the team's faces drawn as readable discs on a firm ink step; a team with nothing in flight says so in its first lane, where a card's key would sit; a flat band is the board's column head on the same grid (stage names and card counts).

action.why: It opens something (a peek, its expansion): a button under the cells, named by its label.

alert.why: A failed action, said under it.

Segmented.why: Filter chips, one row on the bar that never clips: bare words but for the pressed one, filled on a hairline; what doesn't fit goes into a last chip (+N and a chevron), which names the pressed one when it is among them and opens the kit's popover (a combobox, as the other pickers) on its filter field, listing only those hidden filters, each with its count, the pressed one ticked (Compact's top bar).
Segmented.single: Compact's filter today; Settings › Mappings' Try it and the settings nav use it in W8 and W9.

label.why: The group's name, and the overflow filter's prompt (Change filter…).

items.why: The chips, each with a count and mark.

mark.why: The state a pill filters by (MarkKind), a small glyph in the muted ink.

Select.why: A picker (one of a list) as a property chip in a properties row: Base UI's combobox keyboard, filter and placement, the kit's one popover.
Select.single: The ticket's owner today; repos, runtimes and the defaults pick with it in W8 and W9.

label.why: Its accessible name, and the filter's prompt (Change owner…).

options.why: The list, each optionally with a face (a faceless one among faces, Unassigned, gets a dashed no-one ring).

Stack.why: The one layout box: screens lay out with it instead of raw elements.

children.why: What it lays out (none for a spacer).

dir.why: Side by side or one under another.

gap.why: The space between, a spacing token (Space).

values.end: To the end (buttons on the right).

grow.why: Take the free space (and push the rest along).

Stepper.why: A ticket's way through its workflow: V1's stage glyph and labelled stepper on one model.

model.why: Its stages and gates, as the board says.

stages.why: Inbox, the workflow's stages, Done: one segment each.

state.why: Where the ticket is on its way.

values.current: Where it is now: the long segment.
values.skipped: Skipped by the workflow: a dashed hairline and a Skipped caption.

gate.why: The gate after a stage: a diamond.

state.why: Whether the gate has been passed, and who it waits for.

values.waiting: Parked, waiting on someone else: a blue ring.
values.you: Parked, waiting on you: filled blue.

look.why: Rows show the glyph, the ticket and the peek the labelled steps.

values.glyph: The rows' 81px glyph with the stage's name.
values.steps: The labelled stepper: an equal column per stage, its name under its own segment at body size, a gate's diamond where its stage ends.

compact.why: Smaller words and bare diamonds for gates the ticket isn't parked at (an expanded row).

now.why: What happens now (the live run, its step and its Cancel, a gate's ask, a blocked reason) as a full-width line under the stages, set off by space alone (no card), so the stepper and the run read as one strip (the ticket page and the peek).

Surface.why: The one recessed zone per view, and the sheets that rest on it.

values.sheet: A hairline card, as Linear's latest-update card.

fill.why: Fill the page; only the inside scrolls.

label.why: Its accessible name as a region.

Swap.why: A row's end slot in two states, as Linear's triage rows: quiet at rest, the row's one action under the pointer or focus, in the same cell so nothing moves.
Swap.single: Intake's Take in today; My queue's and Compact's row actions can take it up.

children.why: What the slot shows at rest (nothing, or a quiet value).

hover.why: The action that takes its place while the row is hovered or holds focus (Take in).

Tabs.why: Underline tabs on a hairline, as Linear's section tabs (plain words, the current one underlined on the rule): Base UI's roving focus and arrow keys, our look.
Tabs.single: The ticket page's sections today; Settings' areas use them in W8.

items.why: The tabs, each with a count.

Table.why: A dense list on one grid: column head, rows in groups, a foot; rows line up across groups.

columns.why: The grid: widths as tokens, which align right, which hug their content (a list without a head).

width.why: A column's width, a width token (Width).

min.why: A fill column's floor: a list row's title keeps this width before its chips take more.

head.why: Draw the column head (lists whose cells say what they are don't).

scroll.why: Fill the surface and scroll inside it, or sit in a longer page.

foot.why: The bar under the list: key hints, a summary.

bleed.why: Run through the padding of the surface it sits in, edge to edge, flush at its top and foot (My queue's lists, whose surface pads the agents' cards).

measure.why: Hold the head, rows and foot to a reading width, so a row's far end stays near its words (Intake's triage list asks for it).

Text.why: All text on a screen: a role from the type scale, never a raw size.

tone.why: The three inks and the status hues' text colours (Tone).

values.400: Regular: a label-sized line that shouldn't read bold (a run's step).
values.500: Medium: names, a title in a list.
values.600: Semibold: a lead word, a count.

truncate.why: One line (true) or two, cut with an ellipsis.

values.2: Two lines: a title in a tile.

tabular.why: Figures of one width, so counts and times line up.

Thread.why: The conversation as Linear's comments: faces and plain text, mine on the right in a bubble, and the composer.

look.why: A whole thread, or one message in a row's expansion.

compose.why: A composer under it, with this placeholder; in a full-height column it sits at the foot. With no messages only the composer draws (the peek pins it at its panel's foot).

Space.why: The spacing scale: a gap or a pad is one of its steps, never a length.

Width.why: Column and slot widths: the tokens a table's grid and a fixed slot are made of.

values.fit: As wide as its content, at least the 2xl column.
values.2xl: 208px: a stage glyph and its label.

Tone.why: Text colours: the three inks and the status hues.

MarkKind.why: A ticket's states, one form each (Mark).

values.wait: Waiting on someone: a blue ring.

values.theme: The sidebar: the theme row, the theme menu's trigger.
values.search: The search field; the sidebar head's search button.
values.compose: The sidebar head's new-ticket button, Linear's compose.
values.arrow: Dispatch run's arrow; the Inbox note.
values.check: The selected item in a menu or picker.
values.chevron: A group head's fold; a picker; the sidebar's Space switcher and theme row, menus.
values.caret: A sidebar section's fold, Linear's small solid caret.
values.branch: The ticket's properties: its base branch.
values.workflow: The ticket's properties: its workflow, a stepped path.
values.clock: The ticket's properties: when it opened.
values.high: High priority: all three signal bars lit.
values.low: Low priority: the first of three signal bars lit, so it never reads as a fold chevron.
values.normal: Normal priority: an empty slot, so titles share one x.
values.tick: Done, in a plan and the stepper's last stage.
values.tick-sm: Done, inline in a mark or a head.
